notes: Frozen T_max=1e6 extension of the existing stretched-exponential construction. Uses the same width, eta, batch size, and five seeds as spectral-long-horizon-counterexamples-pilot-v001. Every update is a fresh dense Gaussian minibatch and an explicit full-vector SGD update. Checkpoints preserve both parameter error and RNG state, so resume follows the identical sample tape. No recurrence, spectral binning, or proxy training is permitted.
